Container.Name: BrayDashy
Container.Overview: A custom, beautiful, and highly dynamic Unraid landing page dashboard with dual Sysadmin Mode and Home Mode profiles.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port the dashboard is accessible on

Config.Name: App Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage folder for your dashboard configuration and profiles.

Config.Name: Local Source Share (Optional)
Config.Description: Mount your Unraid Projects/BrayDashy folder to pull local updates directly from Settings without GitHub.

Config.Name: Live Backend Override (Optional)
Config.Description: Mount local backend directly over container backend.

Config.Name: Live Frontend Override (Optional)
Config.Description: Mount local compiled frontend directly over container frontend.
